title: Spectral similarity
summary: A comparison score defined by spectral representation, preprocessing, and peak-matching rules; not automatically an identity probability.
zh_summary: 由谱图表示、预处理及峰匹配规则定义的比较分数，不会自动成为身份正确概率。

title: Retention-time prediction
summary: An estimate of an elution coordinate whose scale, local mapping, and applicability depend on chromatography.
zh_summary: 对洗脱坐标的估计，其尺度、本地映射和适用范围依赖色谱条件。

title: Data leakage
summary: Information crosses the boundary intended to make a model evaluation representative of its claimed use.
zh_summary: 信息跨越了用于使模型评估代表其所声称用途的预设边界。

title: Target-decoy competition
summary: Targets compete with constructed decoys under a defined procedure whose assumptions and reporting unit determine valid error control.
zh_summary: 目标与构造诱饵按明确程序竞争，其假设和报告单位决定错误控制是否有效。

title: Controlled vocabulary
summary: Maintained term identifiers and definitions support shared meaning, while units, versions, and context still require validation.
zh_summary: 维护中的术语标识符和定义支持共享含义，而单位、版本和上下文仍需验证。

title: Provenance
summary: The connected history of inputs, transformations, outputs, and responsibility behind a result.
zh_summary: 结果背后相互连接的输入、转换、输出及责任主体历史。
